meta.name: PBS Kids
meta.description:
PBS KIDS believes the world is full of possibilities, and so is every child. Watch favorites like Daniel Tiger’s Neighborhood, Wild Kratts, and Pinkalicious & Peterrific every day, and catch a special PBS KIDS Family Night every weekend.

Shows: Carl the Collector, Donkey Hodie, Super Why's Comic Book Adventures: Many More Mr. Mores!  Talent Trouble!  The Letter f Fun Fair!, Work It Out Wombats!, Rosie's Rules: The Catrina Mystery  The Lucky Dragon Dance
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, iptv-org
